    tokens = case["tokens"]
    calls = case["calls"]
    # sort by score descending, then by call_id as tie-breaker

    selected = []
    intervals = []
    for c in sorted_calls:
        s, e = c["start"], c["end"]
        overlap = False
        for ss, ee in intervals:
            if not (e <= ss or s >= ee):
                overlap = True
                break
        if not overlap:
            selected.append(c)
            intervals.append((s, e))
    # sort selected by start ascending
    selected.sort(key=lambda c: c["start"])
    result_tokens = []
    i = 0
    n = len(tokens)
    call_idx = 0
    while i < n:
        if call_idx < len(selected) and i == selected[call_idx]["start"]:
            result_tokens.extend(selected[call_idx]["replacement_tokens"])
            i = selected[call_idx]["end"]
            call_idx += 1
        else:
            result_tokens.append(tokens[i])
            i += 1
    selected_call_ids = [c["call_id"] for c in selected]
    return {
        "selected_call_ids": selected_call_ids,
        "tokens": result_tokens
    }"
}
